input.summary: Replace the three-year take-or-pay commitment in §2.1 with a no-minimum-commitment, pay-for-use provision.
input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the USD 2,000,000 per year three-year take-or-pay commitment: our position is no minimum purchase or volume commitment, with fees payable only for Services used or ordered, which also aligns §2.1 with §12.3. If a commitment is essential, we could accept one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment and will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term.
